title: Sebi proposes changes to derivatives settlement, closing auction timings
text: Sebi proposes changes to derivatives settlement, closing auction timings. The regulator has floated two expiry-day settlement methodologies, two alternatives for market timings and changes to order cancellation and Iceberg orders during CAS
